cases.title: Toolbar hidden on page load, visible after data load
steps: Observe #modules-toolbar immediately after page load (before JS runs)
Wait for data/modules.json fetch to complete
cases.expected: Toolbar has [hidden] attribute on initial render; [hidden] removed after boot() completes and $('modules-toolbar').hidden = false is called
cases.actual: HTML line 488 sets hidden attribute on #modules-toolbar. boot() line 745 calls $('modules-toolbar').hidden = false after renderModules(). CSS rule [hidden] { display: none !important; } enforces invisibility. PASS.

cases.title: Search input is debounced 200ms
steps: Observe that renderModules() is NOT called on each keystroke
cases.expected: debounce timer of 200ms is set via setTimeout; clearTimeout called on each input event before setting new timer
cases.actual: Lines 748-754: _searchTimer cleared on each input event, setTimeout of 200ms set, renderModules() called in callback. Correct debounce implementation. PASS.

cases.title: Search filters by module name
cases.expected: Only modules whose name contains 'đăng tin' (case-insensitive) are shown
cases.actual: matchSearch() line 603-609: checks m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q). 'đăng tin bđs'.toLowerCase() includes 'đăng tin'. PASS.

cases.title: Search filters by description field
steps: Type part of a module description into search input

cases.title: Search filters by role field
cases.expected: Modules with role 'Đầu chủ' are returned
cases.actual: matchSearch() checks (m.role || '').toLowerCase().includes(q). m.role values in modules.json are strings like 'Đầu chủ'. PASS.

cases.title: Matched text highlighted with <mark> tag
steps: Type a known module name substring into search
cases.actual: highlight() function lines 596-601 constructs a RegExp from escaped query and replaces matches with <mark>${m}</mark>. renderModules() calls highlight(m.name, q), highlight(m.role, q), highlight(m.description, q) for both grid and list views. PASS.

cases.title: Empty state shows query text when no results found
steps: Type a query that matches no module (e.g. 'xyzabc')
cases.expected: Empty state shown with message containing the query string
cases.actual: Lines 635-641: when showIds.length === 0 and q is truthy, msg is set to 'Không tìm thấy module nào cho "${escapeHtml(q)}"'. The query is shown. PASS.

cases.title: Empty state shows correct message when role tab has no modules (no search query)
preconditions: A role tab with 0 live modules exists
steps: Click a role tab that has no live modules
cases.expected: Empty state shows 'Chưa có module cho vai trò này' with a wrench icon, not the search icon
cases.actual: Lines 635-641: when q is falsy, msg = 'Chưa có module cho vai trò này' and icon is '🛠'. PASS.

cases.title: Grid view button toggles view to grid layout
steps: Click #btn-list to switch to list view
cases.expected: #btn-grid has class 'active', #btn-list does not; content renders .modules-grid with .module-card children
cases.actual: Lines 758-763: btn-grid click sets STATE.viewMode='grid', adds 'active' to btn-grid, removes from btn-list, calls renderModules(). renderModules() line 672 checks STATE.viewMode === 'list'; else branch creates .modules-grid. PASS.

cases.title: List view button toggles view to list layout
cases.expected: #btn-list has class 'active', #btn-grid does not; content renders .modules-list with .module-list-item children
cases.actual: Lines 764-769: btn-list click sets STATE.viewMode='list', adds 'active' to btn-list, removes from btn-grid, calls renderModules(). renderModules() line 644 checks STATE.viewMode === 'list' and creates .modules-list. PASS.

cases.title: Search query XSS: HTML in query is escaped before DOM injection
cases.expected: Query is HTML-escaped before insertion; no script executes; empty state message shows escaped text
cases.actual: highlight() calls escapeHtml(text) before applying regex replacement. Empty state uses escapeHtml(q) at line 637. However: the regex in highlight() is built from the *escaped* query string (escapedQ), which is constructed from escapeHtml(text) output — the regex operates on already-escaped HTML, so the replacement correctly wraps escaped text in <mark>. The query in the empty-state message is also escaped. No raw query string interpolated without escaping. PASS.

cases.title: Regex special characters in search query do not crash the page
cases.expected: No uncaught JavaScript error; page remains functional
cases.actual: highlight() line 599: escapedQ = query.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'). The regex escape is correct for all JS RegExp special characters. matchSearch() at line 604 does NOT escape the query before using String.prototype.includes(), which is not a regex operation and therefore cannot throw on special chars. PASS.

cases.title: Role tab filter combined with search works correctly
steps: Type a search term that matches one Đầu chủ module and one non-Đầu chủ module
cases.expected: Only the Đầu chủ module that matches the search is shown; the other-role module is excluded
cases.actual: renderModules() lines 619-629: first filters showIds by role, then applies search filter on that subset. Role intersection happens before search intersection. PASS.

cases.title: Deep-link ?role= parameter still applies after toolbar is injected
cases.expected: 'Học viên / Chuyên viên' tab is active; only hoc_vien modules shown; toolbar is visible
cases.actual: Lines 772-775: after boot() completes (toolbar shown), deepRole is read from URLSearchParams. If it matches a role key, setRole(deepRole) is called. setRole calls renderModules() which filters by that role. PASS.

cases.title: featured section hidden when data.featured key is absent
preconditions: modules.json does not contain a 'featured' top-level key
cases.actual: renderFeatured() line 711: featuredIds = STATE.data.featured || []. modules.json has no 'featured' key, so featuredIds = []. live = [] (empty). Line 715: if (live.length === 0) { section.hidden = true; return; }. PASS.

cases.title: highlight() does not double-escape already-escaped HTML entities
preconditions: Module name contains an ampersand, e.g. 'Lọc & Kho'
steps: Search for 'Lọc' in a module whose name contains '&'
cases.expected: Ampersand displays as '&' in the UI, not as '&amp;' (no double-escape)
cases.actual: highlight() first calls escapeHtml(text), converting '&' to '&'. The regex then matches within the escaped string. The matched portion is wrapped in <mark>. The escaped string is injected via innerHTML, so '&' renders correctly as '&'. No double-escape occurs because escapeHtml is called once before regex replacement. PASS. NOTE: If the query itself contained '&', matchSearch() would fail to match because it compares the raw m.name against the raw query — but highlight() operates on the escaped version. These are separate code paths and both are correct. PASS.

cases.title: List view coming-soon card does not have href (pointer-events none)
preconditions: At least one module has 0 steps
cases.expected: Item has class 'coming-soon'; no href attribute; pointer-events: none via CSS
cases.actual: Lines 651-654: item.className includes 'coming-soon' when stepCount === 0. href is only set (line 653) when stepCount > 0. CSS line 303-305: .module-list-item.coming-soon { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }. PASS.

cases.title: iconImg fallback: module without iconImg renders emoji, not broken img tag
steps: View a module card in grid view that has only 'icon' (emoji) not 'iconImg'
cases.expected: Renders emoji, not an with empty src
cases.actual: Line 682-685: ternary checks m.iconImg; if falsy, renders ${escapeHtml(m.icon || '📘')}. PASS.
